questions.question: Where does a Mixpanel secret go when you configure an MCP server?
options: In an environment variable, referenced as ${VAR}
questions.explanation: Never a literal token in a file in a repo. ${VAR} expands from your shell.

questions.question: A KR read through MCP goes into STATUS.md with Source...
options: mcp:<server> plus the query, and an as-of date
No source needed, it is automatic
questions.explanation: The query is the source. mcp:<server> + query + date lets anyone rerun it.

questions.question: Which scope shares an MCP server with whoever clones your workspace?
questions.explanation: .mcp.json in the folder is project scope: shared. User scope is yours everywhere.

questions.question: Read-only posture means...
options: Only reading tools until a write gets an explicit go
questions.explanation: Reads are free; writes to Meta, Slack, Supabase wait for a go, one at a time.
